# three-vrm 3.5.5

`three-vrm.module.min.js` and `LICENSE` from
`https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@pixiv/three-vrm@3.5.5/lib/` on 2026-10-08
. pixiv Inc., MIT licence, peer `three >= 0.137`;
used with the vendored three r186. Loads VRM 0.x and 1.0 models (MToon
materials, spring bones, the normalised humanoid). Only import is `"three"`,
so the page's import map must name it.
